Planned readiness and BEGIN READ ONLY/schema SELECT/ROLLBACK checks are disclosed operations; captured PG_VERSION=16 and the accepted namespace observations are retained.

no_proxy_redirect.basis: SHOWN within the planned owning-container local PostgreSQL socket path with explicit host/user/database. HTTP proxy/redirect behavior is outside that local client operation, not a daemon-wide assertion.

zero_retries.basis: SHOWN for the planned local-socket pg_isready/read-only psql checks: no HTTP transport or application resend loop is invoked inside this subject by these checks. Separate readiness and schema operations are not retries of one another. No physical connection count is asserted.

risks: No PostgreSQL daemon or libpq-internal effect-free/retry claim is made; connection selection is not SQL resubmission.
Namespace/version observations are historical; existing fresh checks still apply.

no_proxy_redirect.basis: SHOWN for those fixed 127.0.0.1:6333 routes: trust_env=False on client/transport and follow_redirects=False, allowlisted path and bounded response handling.
